reused_architecture: transaction lifecycle rollback_observed -> rolled_back evidence contract
contract: Verification starts only from lifecycle phase rollback_observed.
Evidence must bind the exact transaction and bound pre-state digest.
A fresh independently acquired managed-state read-back is compared against the pre-state projection using the generic 13.6 verifier.
Management and connectivity recovery are mandatory independent conditions.
Only zero drift can set managed_objects_reconciled=true and produce evidence eligible for rolled_back transition.
The verifier exposes no transport, apply, rollback or production-writer capability.
